background_setting: A residential suburban neighborhood under a clear blue sky. The road is a quiet two-lane street with double yellow center lines and a painted stop-lane marker on the asphalt at the intersection ahead. Single-family houses with well-maintained hedges line the right side; on the left there is a red brick wall and additional parked vehicles. Overhead utility poles and crisscrossing wires are visible against the sky, and bare trees line the streets, suggesting late winter or early spring. A stop sign is visible to the right at the intersection.

lighting.shadows: Sharp, short shadows from poles, trees, and parked vehicles on the asphalt
lighting.illumination_effect: Strong directional sunlight, slight overexposure in the brightest patches of sky, vivid colors on hedges and house facades

aesthetics.composition: Forward dashcam framing with the road receding into the distance, dashboard and hood occupying the lower fifth of the frame, the intersection centered in the middle distance
aesthetics.color_scheme: Pale-blue sky, warm beige and red house and brick tones on the right, muted grey-blue asphalt, leafless tree silhouettes
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating vertical rhythm of utility poles along the right side of the street

context: Suburban residential autonomous-vehicle dashcam clip approaching and yielding at a low-traffic intersection

actions.description: The ego vehicle is moving slowly forward toward the intersection; the white car is in the intersection completing a right turn
The white car finishes its right turn and exits the frame to the right; the ego continues decelerating
The ego comes to a full stop at the painted stop-lane marker, yielding to oncoming traffic while preparing to turn right
The ego remains stopped; the residential scene stays still, with the bright daylight and clear sky unchanged

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego rolls slowly forward toward the intersection while a white car turns right in the middle distance. At 0:01 the white car is mid-turn. At 0:02 the white car exits the frame to the right. At 0:03 the ego continues decelerating toward the stop-lane marker. At 0:04 the ego is nearly stopped at the marker. At 0:05 the ego is fully stopped, yielding. At 0:06 the scene is still and bright. At 0:07 no traffic crosses; the scene remains calm. At 0:08 the ego is still stopped at the intersection, waiting to turn right.
